clozeTemplate: We need to ___ ___ ___ on this by Friday.
situationTr: [Teams, ekip kanalı] Bu konuda son tarihi hatırlatıyorsun: "Bu konuda Cuma'ya kadar karar vermemiz gerekiyor."
acceptedAnswers: We need to make a decision on this by Friday.
We need to make a decision about this by Friday.
We have to make a decision on this by Friday.
We have to make a decision about this by Friday.
We must make a decision on this by Friday.
We need to take a decision on this by Friday.
modelSentences: We need to make a decision on this by Friday.
Who is going to make the final decision?
It is hard to make a decision without more data.
commonMistake: We need to do a decision on this by Friday.
checklistTr: Karar için make kullandın mı? (do / give değil)
make a decision: a (tanımlık) var mı?
Son tarih için by Friday yazdın mı?
noteTr: Türkçe "karar vermek" der; İngilizce give / do değil make a decision ister. BrE'de take a decision de kullanılır (daha resmî); AmE'de make yaygındır, bağlama göre değişir.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Longman decision collocations: make a decision; take a decision marked British English (= important or formal decision), which supports the noteTr register claim. Cambridge decision: decision on. SkELL make a decision on: 541 lines. Ngram do a decision = 0.01% of make a decision (Longman common error family). Fix: situationTr typo (Konuda -> Bu konuda).

clozeTemplate: I ___ a ___ and deployed to the wrong environment.
situationTr: [Teams, ekip kanalı] Hatanı kabul ediyorsun: "Hata yaptım, yanlış ortama deploy ettim."
acceptedAnswers: I made a mistake and deployed to the wrong environment.

commonMistake: I did a mistake and deployed to the wrong environment.
checklistTr: Hata için make kullandın mı? (do değil)
make fiilini doğru zamanda çektin mi? (made / have made)
a mistake: tanımlık var mı?
noteTr: Türkçe "hata yapmak" der; İngilizcede do a mistake denmez, make a mistake denir. Yazılım bağlamında bir de "my mistake" kısa biçimi vardır.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Longman mistake: COMMON ERRORS says do a mistake is wrong, say make a mistake. Oxford mistake: make a mistake. Ngram did a mistake = 0.07% of made a mistake. Fix: work context (04 §2.3 work_vocab needs a work channel); bus scene replaced by a deploy to the wrong environment; cloze, answers, model 1 and mistake updated.

clozeTemplate: We're ___ ___ ___ on the regression tests.

checklistTr: İlerleme için make progress kullandın mı? (do / take değil)
progress sayılamaz: progresses ya da a progress yazmadın, değil mi?
on / with ile konuyu bağladın mı?
noteTr: Türkçe "ilerleme kaydetmek" der; İngilizcede make progress denir ve progress sayılamaz isimdir (a progress / progresses yok). Standup'ta en doğal kalıplardan biri.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Longman progress: make progress, progress on, made good progress with; usage note says progress is not used with a. Oxford progress: progress on something. SkELL make progress on: 291 lines. Ngram do progress = 0.86% of make progress. No change.

targetChunk: make changes / a change to something
clozeTemplate: I ___ a few ___ to the config file.
situationTr: [Jira yorumu] Yaptığın işi bildiriyorsun: "Yapılandırma dosyasında birkaç değişiklik yaptım."

checklistTr: Değişiklik için make kullandın mı? (do değil)
change sayılabilir mi? (a few changes, some changes)
to ile neyin değiştiğini bağladın mı?
noteTr: Türkçe "değişiklik yapmak" der; İngilizcede make changes denir (do changes değil). Değişikliğin yapıldığı yer için changes to ... kullanılır.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Longman change collocations: make a change, make some changes to the design. Ngram did some changes = 1.47% of made some changes (did a few changes = 0, so the mistake now uses some). changes in the config file kept: location reading is natural.

clozeTemplate: We should ___ ___ some research before choosing a new tool.
situationTr: [Teams] Karar öncesi bir adım öneriyorsun: "Yeni bir araç seçmeden önce biraz araştırma yapmalıyız."
acceptedAnswers: We should carry out some research before choosing a new tool.
We should carry out some research before we choose a new tool.
We need to carry out some research before choosing a new tool.
We need to carry out some research before we choose a new tool.
We should conduct some research before choosing a new tool.
We should do some research before choosing a new tool.
We should do some research before we choose a new tool.

commonMistake: We should make some research before choosing a new tool.
checklistTr: Araştırma için carry out / conduct / do kullandın mı? (make değil)
research sayılamaz: researches yazmadın, değil mi?
before'dan sonra -ing ya da özne + fiil var mı?
noteTr: Türkçe "araştırma yapmak" der; İngilizcede make research denmez. Resmî dilde carry out / conduct research, günlük dilde do some research kullanılır; bağlama göre üçü de olur.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Longman research: do/carry out research (conduct research formal) and COMMON ERRORS: do not say make research. Oxford research: do/conduct/undertake research; plural researches is rare BrE. SkELL carry out some research: 11 lines. Ngram make some research is far below do/carry out/conduct. No change.

clozeTemplate: We need to ___ ___ before customers notice.
situationTr: [Teams, olay kanalı] Aciliyeti vurguluyorsun: "Müşteriler fark etmeden önce harekete geçmeliyiz."
acceptedAnswers: We need to take action before customers notice.
We need to take action before the customers notice.
We have to take action before customers notice.
We should take action before customers notice.
We must take action before customers notice.
We should take action before the customers notice.
modelSentences: We need to take action before customers notice.
The team took action as soon as the alert fired.
If nobody takes action now, the problem will get worse.
commonMistake: We need to do an action before customers notice.
checklistTr: "Harekete geçmek" için take action yazdın mı? (do an action değil)
Kalıbı tanımlıksız (take action) kurdun mu?
before'dan sonra şimdiki zaman var mı? (notice, will notice değil)
noteTr: Türkçe "harekete geçmek / önlem almak" tek ifadedir; İngilizcede take action denir ve action bu anlamda sayılamazdır. take steps / take measures de yakın anlamlıdır.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Longman action: take action (= do something to deal with a problem), 14 hits. Oxford action: to take action/steps/measures. Ngram do an action = 0.54% of take action. take an action = 2.47% (used in AmE/tech), so the checklist no longer calls it wrong; it only asks for the article-free form.

patternSlots: I don't want to take a ___ ...
clozeTemplate: I don't want to ___ ___ ___ by releasing on Friday.
situationTr: [Teams, sürüm kararı] Ekibe yazıyorsun: "Cuma günü yayına alarak risk almak istemiyorum."
acceptedAnswers: I don't want to take a risk by releasing on Friday.
I don't want to take risks by releasing on Friday.
I don't want to take any risks by releasing on Friday.
I don't want to take the risk of releasing on Friday.
modelSentences: I don't want to take a risk by releasing on Friday.
Mert took a risk and shipped the fix without a review.
Nobody wants to take a risk with customer data.
checklistTr: "Risk almak" için take kullandın mı? (get / do değil)
take fiilinden sonra a risk / risks / the risk of kullandın mı?
by + -ing ile nasıl yapıldığını bağladın mı?
noteTr: Türkçe "risk almak" der; İngilizcede de take a risk / take risks denir. take the risk of + -ing ise neyin riskini aldığını söyler; ikisi de bağlama göre doğrudur.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Oxford risk: take a risk / take risks. Longman risk: take a risk, take the risk of doing something. SkELL take a risk by: 38 lines. Fixes: work context (hiking -> releasing on Friday); commonMistake get a risk removed (SkELL 0 real lines, Ngram 0.40% mostly other senses); unsupported "more formal" claim removed from noteTr.

targetChunk: pay attention to something (not give / put)
clozeTemplate: Please ___ ___ to the error messages.
situationTr: [Code review] Takım arkadaşına hatırlatıyorsun: "Lütfen hata mesajlarına dikkat et."
acceptedAnswers: Please pay attention to the error messages.
Please pay close attention to the error messages.
Pay attention to the error messages.
Please pay careful attention to the error messages.
modelSentences: Please pay attention to the error messages.
You should pay attention to the logs before you restart the service.

commonMistake: Please put attention to the error messages.
checklistTr: "Dikkat etmek" için pay attention yazdın mı? (put / make değil)
pay attention'dan sonra to koydun mu?
attention sayılamaz: a attention / attentions yazmadın, değil mi?
noteTr: Türkçe "dikkat etmek" tek fiildir; İngilizcede pay attention to denir (put / make attention değil). Vurgu için pay close attention to kullanılır.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Longman attention: pay attention to something/somebody. Oxford attention: Please pay close attention to. Ngram give attention to = 4.31% (correct English), so the old mistake was replaced by put attention to = 0.03%. noteTr said pay = harcamak, which is wrong (Oxford: pay = give attention); rewritten.

clozeTemplate: It is ___ ___ that the bug comes from the API.
situationTr: [Jira yorumu] Bir hipotezi değerlendiriyorsun: "Hatanın API'den kaynaklanması çok düşük bir ihtimal."
acceptedAnswers: It is highly unlikely that the bug comes from the API.
It is highly unlikely that the bug is caused by the API.
It is highly unlikely that the API causes the bug.
It is extremely unlikely that the bug comes from the API.
It is extremely unlikely that the bug is caused by the API.
It is very unlikely that the bug comes from the API.
modelSentences: It is highly unlikely that the bug comes from the API.
It is highly unlikely that Ayşe's change broke the build.
That scenario is highly unlikely, but we should still test it.
commonMistake: It is strongly unlikely that the bug comes from the API.
checklistTr: highly unlikely yazdın mı? (strongly unlikely değil)
unlikely ile It is ... that kalıbını kurdun mu?
that'ten sonra tam bir cümle (özne + fiil) var mı?
noteTr: Türkçe "çok düşük ihtimal" der; İngilizcede pekiştirici zarf sıfata göre seçilir: highly unlikely / improbable, ama strongly unlikely denmez. very unlikely de doğrudur ama daha sıradan; highly daha resmî ve yazılı dildedir.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Oxford unlikely: highly unlikely, extremely unlikely in the it is unlikely that pattern. Longman unlikely collocations: highly/most/very unlikely. Ngram strongly unlikely = 0.01%. Fix: very unlikely added (noteTr calls it correct; Ngram 71% of highly unlikely); checklist 2 rewritten (was unclear).

clozeTemplate: I ___ ___ running one more regression round before the release.
situationTr: [Teams, sürüm kararı] Ekibe tavsiye veriyorsun: "Yayından önce bir regresyon turu daha yapmanızı şiddetle tavsiye ederim."
acceptedAnswers: I strongly recommend running one more regression round before the release.
I strongly recommend that you run one more regression round before the release.
I would strongly recommend running one more regression round before the release.
I would strongly recommend that you run one more regression round before the release.
I highly recommend running one more regression round before the release.
modelSentences: I strongly recommend running one more regression round before the release.
We strongly recommend updating the browser before testing.
Ayşe strongly recommended that we back up the data first.
commonMistake: I strongly recommend to run one more regression round before the release.
checklistTr: strongly recommend yazdın mı? (şiddetle: heavily / hardly değil)
recommend'dan sonra -ing ya da that cümlesi var mı? (recommend to run değil)
Yayın öncesi (before the release) bilgisini yazdın mı?
noteTr: Türkçe "-mesini tavsiye ederim" der; İngilizcede recommend + -ing ya da recommend that + özne + yalın fiil kullanılır, recommend to run (nesnesiz to) yanlıştır. strongly ve highly recommend yerleşiktir; would eklemek tonu yumuşatır.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Cambridge recommend: [+ (that)] and [+ -ing verb]. Longman recommend: recommend doing something; strongly recommend that. Oxford recommend lists recommend somebody to do something (BrE) and Ngram recommend you to is common, so the old mistake was not wrong; replaced by recommend to run (no object) = 4.5% of recommend running. noteTr updated.

clozeTemplate: We are ___ ___ of the delay.
situationTr: [E-posta, paydaşa] Gecikmeyi kabul ediyorsun: "Gecikmenin tamamen farkındayız."
acceptedAnswers: We are fully aware of the delay.
We are well aware of the delay.
We are fully aware of this delay.
We are well aware of this delay.
We are all fully aware of the delay.
We are very aware of the delay.
modelSentences: We are fully aware of the delay.
Mert is fully aware of the risks.
We are fully aware that the deadline is tight.
commonMistake: We are fully aware about the delay.
checklistTr: aware'i fully / well ile güçlendirdin mi?
aware'den sonra of koydun mu? (about değil)
Özne ve be fiili (We are) doğru mu?
noteTr: Türkçe "-in farkında olmak" ekle kurulur; İngilizcede aware of denir (aware about değil) ve en yerleşik pekiştiriciler fully / well'dir. that cümlesi gelirse of düşer: fully aware that ...
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Oxford aware: fully aware of the fact, well aware of the problem. Longman aware: fully aware of. Ngram aware about the = 0.25% of aware of the. Fixes: checklist 1 called very aware wrong, but very aware of = 41% of fully aware of and noteTr allowed it; very aware added to answers, checklist and noteTr aligned.

clozeTemplate: I am ___ ___ about the test coverage.
situationTr: [Teams, QA lideri olarak] Kaygını dile getiriyorsun: "Test kapsamı konusunda derinden endişeliyim."
acceptedAnswers: I am deeply concerned about the test coverage.
I am deeply concerned about our test coverage.
I am deeply worried about the test coverage.
I am deeply worried about our test coverage.

modelSentences: I am deeply concerned about the test coverage.

checklistTr: deeply concerned yazdın mı? (heavily / hardly değil)
concerned'dan sonra konu için about koydun mu?
Konuyu (the test coverage) belirttin mi?
noteTr: Türkçe "derinden endişeli" der; İngilizcede deeply concerned / worried about yerleşik eş-dizimdir (concerned for daha çok birinin güvenliği ya da geleceği için kullanılır). Resmî bir tondur; ekip içi sohbette very concerned daha doğal olabilir.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Oxford concerned: The president is deeply concerned about this issue; concerned for something/somebody also listed. Longman concerned: concerned about, concerned for (safety). Ngram concerned for the = 8% of concerned about the and is correct English, so the commonMistake was removed. noteTr cut to 2 sentences.

clozeTemplate: I am ___ ___ today.
situationTr: [Teams, ekip arkadaşına] Uzun sürüm gecesinden sonra yazıyorsun: "Bugün tamamen bitkinim."
acceptedAnswers: I am absolutely exhausted today.
I am utterly exhausted today.
I am completely exhausted today.
I am totally exhausted today.
I am really exhausted today.
modelSentences: I am absolutely exhausted today.
The whole team was absolutely exhausted by Friday.
After the night shift, Deniz looked utterly exhausted.
commonMistake: I am absolutely tired today.
checklistTr: Aşırı sıfatla (exhausted) absolutely / utterly / completely kullandın mı?
very exhausted yerine absolutely exhausted yazdın mı?
Sıradan sıfatla (tired) absolutely kullanmadın, değil mi?
noteTr: Türkçe "çok" her sıfatla kullanılır; İngilizcede absolutely / utterly yalnız exhausted, terrible, delighted gibi uç sıfatlarla gelir, tired gibi sıradan sıfatlarla very kullanılır.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Cambridge Grammar very: extreme adjectives take absolutely, completely, really, totally, not normally very. Oxford absolutely: used with adjectives that express extreme qualities. Longman absolutely example with exhausted. Ngram absolutely tired = 6% (informal, against the Cambridge rule). Fixes: work context; really exhausted added (Cambridge lists really).

clozeTemplate: Can you ___ ___ that the fix works?
situationTr: [Jira yorumu] Geliştiriciden istiyorsun: "Düzeltmenin çalıştığına dair kanıt sağlayabilir misin?"
acceptedAnswers: Can you provide evidence that the fix works?

Could you provide some evidence that the fix works?

Could you provide evidence that the fix is working?
modelSentences: Can you provide evidence that the fix works?

commonMistake: Can you provide an evidence that the fix works?
checklistTr: "Kanıt sunmak" için provide evidence kalıbını kurdun mu?
evidence sayılamaz: an evidence / evidences yazmadın, değil mi?
that'ten sonra tam cümle var mı?
noteTr: Türkçe "kanıt sunmak" der; iş dilinde en yerleşik karşılık provide evidence'tır (give evidence daha çok mahkemede ifade vermek için kullanılır). evidence sayılamaz: an evidence / evidences denmez, gerekirse a piece of evidence denir.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Cambridge evidence: provided the forensic evidence; evidence that. Longman evidence: provides compelling evidence that; Don't say evidences; a piece of evidence. Ngram give evidence that = 10% of provide evidence that, so give was not a clear error; mistake changed to provide an evidence = 0.98%. noteTr updated.

clozeTemplate: We shouldn't ___ ___ ___ from a single test.
situationTr: [RCA toplantısı] Dikkatli olmayı hatırlatıyorsun: "Tek bir testten sonuç çıkarmamalıyız."
acceptedAnswers: We shouldn't draw a conclusion from a single test.

We shouldn't draw conclusions from just one test.

commonMistake: We shouldn't take a conclusion from a single test.
checklistTr: "Sonuç çıkarmak" için draw a conclusion yazdın mı? (take / pull / get değil)
from ile kaynağı (a single test) belirttin mi?
conclusion sayılabilir: a conclusion / conclusions doğru mu?
noteTr: Türkçe "sonuç çıkarmak" der; İngilizcede çıkarılan şey "çekilir": draw a conclusion. Resmî ve yazılı dilde (RCA, rapor) yaygındır.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Longman conclusion: draw a conclusion. Cambridge conclusion: reach/come to/draw a conclusion. Ngram take a conclusion = 0.25%, take conclusions from = 0.08% (make a conclusion = 20%, so it is not used as the mistake). draw any conclusions = 75% of draw conclusions from. No change.

clozeTemplate: We need to ___ the budget ___ ___.
situationTr: [Teams] Planlama sırasında hatırlatıyorsun: "Bütçeyi de dikkate almamız lazım."
acceptedAnswers: We need to take the budget into consideration.

checklistTr: take ... into consideration yazdın mı? (take in consideration değil)
Nesne take ile into arasında mı? (take the budget into consideration)
consideration'dan önce a / the koymadın, değil mi?
noteTr: Türkçe "dikkate almak" tek fiildir; İngilizcede take sth into consideration / into account denir ve nesne take ile into arasına girer. Hatalı take in consideration sık görülür.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Oxford consideration: take something into consideration. Longman consideration: take something into consideration. Ngram take in consideration = 0.93% of take into consideration. Fix: checklist 3 rewritten (old line was vague).

patternSlots: I want to draw attention to ...
clozeTemplate: I want to ___ ___ to a problem in the report.
situationTr: [Teams] Raporu paylaşırken öne çıkarıyorsun: "Rapordaki bir soruna dikkat çekmek istiyorum."
acceptedAnswers: I want to draw attention to a problem in the report.
I would like to draw attention to a problem in the report.
I'd like to draw attention to a problem in the report.
I want to draw your attention to a problem in the report.
I would like to draw your attention to a problem in the report.
I'd like to draw your attention to a problem in the report.
I want to draw attention to an issue in the report.
I'd like to draw attention to an issue in the report.
modelSentences: I want to draw attention to a problem in the report.

commonMistake: I want to pull attention to a problem in the report.
checklistTr: "Dikkat çekmek" için draw attention yazdın mı? (pull attention değil)
draw attention'dan sonra to koydun mu?
attention'dan önce a / the koymadın, değil mi?
noteTr: Türkçe "dikkat çekmek"teki çekmek burada pull değil draw olur: draw attention to. draw your attention to daha resmî ve kibar bir giriştir; attract attention ise daha çok insanların bakmasını sağlamak demektir.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Oxford attention: I would like to draw attention to; Cambridge attention: draw attention to. Longman attention: draw attention to. Ngram attract attention to = 4.45% (used in real English), so mistake changed to the Turkish calque pull attention to = 0.03%. Fixes: I'd like variants added (normaliser does not expand I'd); checklist 3 was about draws, which the cloze never uses.

clozeTemplate: The ___ ___ of the issue is an old configuration.
situationTr: [RCA belgesi] Olay analizinde yazıyorsun: "Sorunun kök nedeni eski bir yapılandırma."
acceptedAnswers: The underlying cause of the issue is an old configuration.

The root cause of the problem is an old configuration.

commonMistake: The root reason of the issue is an old configuration.
checklistTr: underlying / root cause yazdın mı? (root reason değil)
cause'dan sonra of ile sorunu bağladın mı?
noteTr: Türkçe "kök neden" der; İngilizcede reason değil cause kullanılır: root cause (olay analizi / RCA terimi) ya da underlying cause (genel dil). İkisi de bağlama göre doğrudur.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Oxford underlying: an underlying cause of; Cambridge underlying causes; Longman underlying cause/reason. Oxford root: the root cause of the problem; Cambridge root cause. Ngram basic cause of = 11% (correct English), so mistake changed to root reason of = 0.08%. noteTr no longer follows the source unit's immediate/underlying contrast.

We have switched to the backup server to minimize the impact.

We switched to the backup server in order to minimize the impact.

checklistTr: "En aza indirmek" için minimise (fiil) yazdın mı? (minimum isim / sıfat)
the impact: tanımlık var mı?
BrE minimise / AmE minimize: ikisi de doğru, ama tutarlı mı?
noteTr: Türkçe "en aza indirmek" tek fiildir; İngilizcede minimise (BrE) / minimize (AmE) fiili kullanılır, minimum ise isim ya da sıfattır. reduce the impact (azaltmak) da doğrudur ama "en aza" anlamını taşımaz.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Oxford minimize (BrE also minimise): minimize the risk/effects; Oxford impact: to reduce/minimize the impact of something. Longman minimize (also minimise BrE). Ngram minimum the impact = 0.86%. Fix: noteTr mitigate line replaced by reduce, the near collocate Oxford lists.

patternSlots: I tend to agree with ... on ...
clozeTemplate: I ___ ___ ___ with Deniz on this.
situationTr: [Toplantı] Sert çıkmadan kısmen katılıyorsun: "Deniz'e bu konuda katılmaya meyilliyim."
acceptedAnswers: I tend to agree with Deniz on this.
I tend to agree with Deniz about this.
I tend to agree with Deniz here.
I do tend to agree with Deniz on this.
modelSentences: I tend to agree with Deniz on this.
I tend to agree, but let's check the numbers first.
Most testers tend to agree that exploratory testing finds odd bugs.
commonMistake: I tend to agree to Deniz on this.
checklistTr: I tend to agree with yazdın mı? (agree to değil)
tend'den sonra to ve yalın fiil var mı?
Katıldığın kişiden önce with koydun mu?
noteTr: Türkçe "katılma eğilimindeyim" ek fiille söylenir; İngilizcede I tend to agree (with sb) katılırken kesin konuşmamayı sağlar, diplomatik ve çoğu zaman "ama ..." ile devam eder. agree with sb denir, agree to sb denmez.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Oxford tend: I tend to agree with many of the points you make. SkELL tend to agree with: 180 lines. Ngram tend to agree to = 2.1% of tend to agree with. No change.

targetChunk: agree up to a point (partial agreement)
clozeTemplate: I agree ___ ___ ___ ___, but we still need more tests.
situationTr: [Code review cevabı] Yorumun bir kısmına katılıyorsun: "Bir noktaya kadar katılıyorum, ama yine de daha fazla teste ihtiyacımız var."
acceptedAnswers: I agree up to a point, but we still need more tests.
I agree to a point, but we still need more tests.
I agree up to a certain point, but we still need more tests.
I agree to a certain extent, but we still need more tests.
I agree to some extent, but we still need more tests.
I agree with you up to a point, but we still need more tests.
I agree with you to some extent, but we still need more tests.
modelSentences: I agree up to a point, but we still need more tests.
I agree up to a point, but the deadline is not realistic.
Deniz agreed up to a point, then asked for a demo.
checklistTr: up to a point yazdın mı? (until a point değil)
Katılmadığın kısım için but ile devam ettin mi?
noteTr: Türkçe "bir noktaya kadar" der; İngilizcede up to a point (ya da to a certain extent) denir, until bir zaman sınırıdır. Diplomatik itirazın girişidir: kısmen katılır, sonra "but" ile ayrılırsın.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Oxford point: I agree with you up to a point; Cambridge up to a point (B2, partly); Oxford extent: to a certain/some extent. Ngram agree until a point = 0 and SkELL 0, so the commonMistake was removed (warning kept in checklist). Fix: agree with you variants added (Oxford example form); checklist 3 said with is not needed, which contradicted that.

clozeTemplate: I have ___ ___ about the timeline.
situationTr: [E-posta] Nazik ama net itiraz ediyorsun: "Zaman çizelgesi konusunda ciddi kuşkularım var."
acceptedAnswers: I have serious misgivings about the timeline.
I have serious misgivings about this timeline.
I have serious doubts about the timeline.
I have serious reservations about the timeline.
I have some serious misgivings about the timeline.
I have grave misgivings about the timeline.
modelSentences: I have serious misgivings about the timeline.
Ayşe has serious misgivings about the new release date.
I have serious misgivings about merging this on a Friday.
commonMistake: I have serious misgivings for the timeline.
checklistTr: have serious misgivings yazdın mı? (heavy / big misgivings değil)
misgivings'den sonra about koydun mu? (for değil)
Çoğul misgivings yazdın mı?
noteTr: Türkçe "ciddi kuşku" der; İngilizcede misgivings çoğul ve resmîdir, about ile kullanılır (serious / grave misgivings). serious doubts / reservations yakın anlamlıdır ve iş dilinde "çekince" demektir.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Longman misgiving: grave/serious/deep misgivings, misgiving about. Cambridge misgiving: serious misgivings about. Oxford misgiving: grave misgivings about. Ngram misgivings for = 1.4%, misgivings on = 4.7% (on is used, so checklist now names only for). Fixes: grave added; noteTr cut from 3 to 2 sentences.

clozeTemplate: I'll ___ ___ until I see more data.
situationTr: [Teams] Aceleyle fikir bildirmiyorsun: "Daha fazla veri görene kadar hüküm vermeyi erteleyeceğim."
acceptedAnswers: I'll reserve judgement until I see more data.
I'll reserve judgment until I see more data.
I'll reserve my judgement until I see more data.
I'll reserve my judgment until I see more data.
I'll reserve judgement until I've seen more data.
I'll reserve judgment until I've seen more data.
I'll reserve my judgement until I've seen more data.
I'll reserve my judgment until I've seen more data.
modelSentences: I'll reserve judgement until I see more data.
Let's reserve judgement until the performance tests have finished.
Mert asked us to reserve judgement on the new tool for a week.
commonMistake: I'll keep my judgement until I see more data.
checklistTr: reserve judgement yazdın mı? (keep / save değil)
until'den sonra şimdiki zaman var mı? (until I see, will see değil)
judgement (BrE) / judgment (AmE) yazımını tutarlı seçtin mi?
noteTr: Türkçe "hüküm vermeyi ertelemek" der; İngilizcede reserve judgement (on sth) yerleşik, resmî ve diplomatik bir kalıptır. Yazım BrE judgement, AmE judgment (ikisi de doğru) ve until'den sonra will gelmez.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Cambridge reserve: reserve judgment (= not give an opinion now). Longman reserve: reserve judgement until they see further evidence. SkELL reserve judgement: 40 lines. Ngram keep my judgement = 0.6%. Fixes: situationTr was a word-for-word calque of the target (yargımı saklı tutuyorum); now natural Turkish in future tense; noteTr cut from 4 to 2 sentences.

clozeTemplate: I'm ___ ___ ___ about Friday's release plan.
situationTr: [Teams, ekip arkadaşına] Plandan emin değilsin: "Cuma günkü sürüm planı konusunda tereddüt etmeye başladım."
acceptedAnswers: I'm having second thoughts about Friday's release plan.
I'm having second thoughts about the Friday release plan.
I've started having second thoughts about Friday's release plan.
I'm starting to have second thoughts about Friday's release plan.
I'm beginning to have second thoughts about Friday's release plan.
I have second thoughts about Friday's release plan.
modelSentences: I'm having second thoughts about Friday's release plan.
Ayşe had second thoughts about merging without a review.
If you're having second thoughts, tell me before we start.
commonMistake: I'm having second thought about Friday's release plan.
checklistTr: have second thoughts yazdın mı? (make / do değil)
thoughts çoğul mu? (second thought tekil yazmadın, değil mi?)
about ile konuyu bağladın mı?
noteTr: Türkçe "ikinci kez düşünmek / tereddüt etmek" der; İngilizcede have second thoughts (about sth) denir ve thoughts çoğuldur. Karar sonrası şüpheyi anlatır; iş ve günlük dilde olur.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Oxford thought: have second thoughts (You're not having second thoughts about it?); Cambridge have second thoughts (change your opinion or start to doubt it). Ngram having second thought = 0.10%. Fixes: work context (dinner plan -> release plan); situationTr no longer leaks the target (ikinci kez düşünmek).

clozeTemplate: Thanks for the ___ ___, it really helped.
situationTr: [Teams, code review sonrası] Teşekkür ediyorsun: "Yapıcı eleştiri için teşekkürler, çok işime yaradı."
acceptedAnswers: Thanks for the constructive criticism, it really helped.
Thank you for the constructive criticism, it really helped.
Thanks for the constructive criticism, it was really helpful.
Thank you for the constructive criticism, it was really helpful.
Thanks for your constructive criticism, it really helped.
Thank you for your constructive criticism, it really helped.
modelSentences: Thanks for the constructive criticism, it really helped.
Ayşe gave me constructive criticism on my test plan.
Good review comments should be constructive criticism, not personal attacks.
commonMistake: Thanks for the constructive critic, it really helped.
checklistTr: criticism (isim) yazdın mı? (critic = eleştirmen kişi değil)
Teşekkür nedenini for ile bağladın mı?
noteTr: Türkçe "eleştiri" ve "eleştirmen" ayrı sözcüklerdir; İngilizcede criticism eleştiri, critic eleştirmen kişidir. Code review dilinde olumlu ton için constructive criticism (ya da constructive feedback) kullanılır.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Oxford criticism: to offer somebody constructive criticism; Longman criticism: constructive criticism (= aimed at improving). Ngram constructive critic = 1.8%. Fix: Oxford/Longman mark criticism [U, C], so the checklist line saying criticisms is wrong was removed and noteTr no longer says uncountable.

targetChunk: give credit to someone for something
clozeTemplate: We should ___ ___ to Mert for the demo.
situationTr: [Teams] Başarıyı paylaşıyorsun: "Demo için Mert'in hakkını vermeliyiz."
acceptedAnswers: We should give credit to Mert for the demo.
We should give Mert credit for the demo.

Always give credit to the person who found the issue.
commonMistake: We should give a credit to Mert for the demo.
checklistTr: give credit yazdın mı? (put / make credit değil)
credit sayılamaz: a credit / credits yazmadın, değil mi?
to kişiye, for neden işe bağlandı mı?
noteTr: Türkçe "takdir etmek, emeğini tanımak" der; "kredi" yanıltıcıdır: bu anlamda credit para değil, övgü ve takdirdir. give credit to sb for sth (ya da give sb credit for sth) kullanılır; credit sayılamaz.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Oxford credit: We should give due credit to all who helped; give him credit for trying. Longman credit: give somebody credit for. Ngram give a credit to = 0.40%, give him a credit for = 0.03%. Fix: situationTr leaked the target (krediyi vermek) and had a yani gloss; now the natural Turkish hakkını vermek.

targetChunk: I don't quite understand ... (polite request to clarify)
clozeTemplate: I ___ ___ ___ what you mean.
situationTr: [Teams] Birinin mesajını net anlamadın: "Ne demek istediğini tam anlamadım."
acceptedAnswers: I don't quite understand what you mean.
I'm not quite sure I understand what you mean.
I don't quite follow what you mean.
I don't quite get what you mean.
I don't quite understand what you're saying.

I didn't quite get what you meant.

checklistTr: don't quite understand sırasını kurdun mu? (quite don't değil)

noteTr: Türkçe "tam anlamadım" der; İngilizcede quite olumsuzdan sonra gelir: I don't quite understand. Yumuşatıcıdır: "anlamıyorum" yerine "tam oturmadı" tonu verir ve itiraz öncesi netleştirme istemek için uygundur.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Oxford quite: not quite; I don't quite know; I'm sorry, I don't quite follow. SkELL do n't quite understand: 190 lines; quite do n't understand: 1. Ngram quite do not understand = 0.04% of do not quite understand. Fixes: anlamadım is often rendered in the past, so didn't quite understand/get added; model 3 used see, now understand (same pattern).

clozeTemplate: Let's ___ ___ of the quiet week and fix the old tests.
situationTr: [Teams, ekibe öneri] Plan öneriyorsun: "Sakin haftadan yararlanıp eski testleri düzeltelim."
acceptedAnswers: Let's take advantage of the quiet week and fix the old tests.
Let's take advantage of the quiet week to fix the old tests.

Let's take full advantage of the quiet week to fix the old tests.
modelSentences: Let's take advantage of the quiet week and fix the old tests.
We should take advantage of the quiet morning to update the test data.

commonMistake: Let's take an advantage of the quiet week and fix the old tests.
checklistTr: take advantage of yazdın mı? (get / use advantage değil)
advantage'dan sonra of koydun mu?
Kalıpta advantage'dan önce an / the yok, değil mi?
noteTr: Türkçe "yararlanmak" der; İngilizcede take advantage of (fırsattan yararlanmak) denir ve kalıpta advantage tanımlıksız kalır. Kişiyi sömürmek anlamında da kullanılır (negatif); bağlama göre değişir.
verifiedNote: verifier 2026-10-23: Oxford advantage: take advantage of something (make use of an opportunity); Longman advantage: take advantage of something (to do something). Ngram take an advantage of = 0.05%. Fixes: work context (weather/run -> quiet week/old tests); checklist 3 said advantage is uncountable, but it is countable outside the idiom; now about the article in the idiom.
